nodes.label: SSG pre-rendering & React hydration rules
nodes.rationale: Each rule was a real bug; a hydration mismatch makes React discard the pre-rendered DOM and re-render from scratch on every page load. onRecoverableError logs [hydration] warnings with component stacks — check that first.

nodes.label: minifyAroundRoot (never minify the React subtree)
nodes.rationale: html-minifier's removeComments strips React's <!--$--> Suspense markers and <!-- --> text separators, and collapseWhitespace/minifyCSS rewrite text nodes and style attributes — any of these breaks hydration, so #root innerHTML stays byte-for-byte untouched.

nodes.label: FadeIn / scroll-driven reveal rules
nodes.rationale: Environment detection (CSS.supports) in render made the server emit a hidden class React then refuses to patch, locking content at opacity 0. Hidden state lives only inside keyframes with fill-mode both so an inactive view timeline degrades to visible; reveals are pinned on animationend, and JS-dependent hidden states sit inside @media (scripting: enabled).
